feature: Money path — scheduled cancellation + status sync (MSP platform subscription). customer.subscription.updated mirrors Stripe's own status into the local row and syncs the period window; the scheduled-cancel (cancel_at_period_end) case is proven to mirror as 'active'.
notes: Epic #803 (Money-path lifecycle coverage). Drives the REAL msp-billing-webhook handleSubscriptionUpdated via the dev-origin-gated POST /api/admin/testbed/billing-simulate (same dispatchMspStripeEvent as production). Honest boundary + self-contained testbed setup: see payment-failed-dunning.json notes.

SCHEDULED CANCELLATION SEMANTICS on the MSP channel (documented + asserted): when a customer schedules a cancel_at_period_end, Stripe keeps the subscription status 'active' until the period actually ends, and only then sends customer.subscription.deleted. handleSubscriptionUpdated mirrors subscription.status verbatim and does NOT read/persist cancel_at_period_end — so the local msp_subscriptions row shows 'active' for a subscription that is scheduled to cancel. This test asserts that real behavior (status stays 'active' after the cancel_at_period_end update). LIMITATION worth Shane's awareness: the local row cannot distinguish 'active' from 'active-but-ending' — the pending-cancel is only visible in Stripe until the period-end deleted event (covered by cancellation-immediate.json).

STATUS SYNC: the same handler is the ONLY place Stripe's active → past_due → active status is mirrored for the MSP channel, so this manifest also fires a real status change (active → past_due → active) and asserts each mirrors, catching a regression where the mirror freezes on one value.

VERIFY — a scheduled-to-cancel subscription still mirrors as 'active' locally (documented behavior)

body.query: SELECT status FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — the period window was synced from the event (current_period_end set)

body.query: SELECT (current_period_end IS NOT NULL) AS period_set FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'
